question: Which one of the following has the largest population in a food chain?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Decomposers**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Decomposers** have the largest population in a food chain.
 
• Decomposers include organisms such as bacteria and fungi that break down dead organic matter.
 
• They play a crucial role in the ecosystem by recycling nutrients back into the soil, which are then used by producers (plants).
